stories.title: Two Flintshire teenagers attend Rolls-Royce launch of new Scouts programme
stories.summary: Two Explorer Scouts from Flintshire have joined Chief Scout Dwayne Fields at Rolls-Royce in Derby for the national launch of a refreshed Scouts programme for 14 to 18 year olds. stories.title: Public consultation launched on new North Wales fire training centre

stories.title: Construction begins on Shotton church community hub conversion
stories.summary: Construction has started on the redevelopment of Rivertown United Reformed Church in Shotton into a community hub. Gareth Morris Construction Ltd, a contractor based in Pontfadog near Llangollen, has been appointed as main contractor for the project. Work began on site on Monday, 29 June. stories.title: Hundreds of fish stocked at Greenfield Valley’s Meadow Mill Pool
stories.summary: Greenfield Valley Trust has announced improvements to Meadow Mill Fishing Pool, following a public meeting with local anglers. stories.title: Conservative leader raises Visitor Levy concerns on Flintshire visit
stories.summary: Clwyd MS Darren Millar visited Tree Tops Caravan Park in Gwespyr on Friday. He was shown around the site by owner Andy Walker. According to a press release from Millar’s office, the park includes a children’s play area, an outdoor gym, a launderette, a library, two dog-walking areas, and Japanese and Sensory gardens.
